description: Figure 7 presents the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations. The pie chart contains five slices, representing “Article generation” (16.8%), “Headline generation” (12.6%), “Task” (83.2%), “Article editing” (4.1%), and “Article” (2.7%). The slices are colored in shades of blue and gray. The chart includes a legend labeling each task type and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest, visually progressing clockwise around the circle.
